name: Cathay Pacific Credit Card

apr.notes: New Accounts as of 01/26: Variable Purchase APR 24.99%, 27.99% or 30.99%. Cash APR 34.99% and 5% Fee ($10 min). Variable Bal Trans APR 24.99%, 27.99% or 30.99% and 5% Fee ($5 min). Variable Penalty APR 34.99%, 37.99% or 39.99%. Min Interest Charge $2.

base_rate.description: Earn 1 per USD1 from spend on everything else, where Mastercard is accepted worldwide.

rewards.redemption_notes: Redeem Asia Miles for flights with Cathay Pacific, oneworld and partner airlines; hotels; car rentals; lifestyle awards. 10% redemption discount on hotel and experiences awards with Asia Miles.

signup_bonus.description: Earn 38,000 bonus Asia Miles when you open an account and spend USD 3,000 in the first 90 days of account opening.

benefits.title: Business Class lounge redemption
benefits.description: Primary cardholders may use their Asia Miles to redeem access to Cathay Pacific Business Class lounges.

benefits.title: 10% redemption discount on hotel and experiences awards
benefits.description: 10% redemption discount on hotel and experiences awards with Asia Miles.

benefits.title: Priority check-in
benefits.description: Primary cardholders may check in at Premium Economy class airport check-in counters. Travel companion(s) can also enjoy this benefit when travelling with the Primary cardholder.

benefits.title: Priority boarding
benefits.description: Primary cardholders can enjoy the same boarding line as Premium Economy class passengers on flights operated by Cathay Pacific.

benefits.title: Save up to 15% on eligible flights
benefits.description: From now until Dec 31, 2026, enter promotion code and pay with your Cathay World Elite Mastercard to enjoy up to 15% savings on eligible flights when making your flight booking on select fare classes.

benefits.title: Earn 10 Status Points per USD5,000 spent
benefits.description: Earn 10 Status Points for every USD5,000 in eligible purchases made each month, up to a maximum of 100 Status Points per calendar year.

lounge_access.notes: Business Class lounge redemption using Asia Miles
